description.value:
You can be someone else briefly. You come back slightly less each time.

Gift — For up to an hour you can slacken toward the features of anyone you have touched in the last day: +4 circumstance bonus to Impersonate them. Tithe — Something of yours doesn't return. After each use the GM may rule that a detail of your face, voice or habit is permanently gone, and you do not choose which.

cinderfall.incomplete: "+4 circumstance bonus to Impersonate them" (someone touched in the last day) has a real predicate for Impersonate itself (action:impersonate, confirmed in pf2e-source), but no mechanism exists for tracking 'has this actor touched this specific target within the last day' -- applying the bonus unconditionally to all Impersonate checks would misstate a narrow, touch-gated ability as a permanent one, so it's flagged rather than overbroadened.
